prompts.fisherman: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production animation rig parts atlas, true transparent background, square 1536 x 1536 if possible. Input image is the Kilo King fisherman identity/style reference. Make a clean 3-column by 3-row atlas with nine isolated pieces, one piece centered in each equal cell, generous transparent gutters, NO labels, NO dividing lines, NO background. Preserve EXACT character: navy rib-knit beanie, same handsome broad bearded face and smirk, orange glossy fishing vest, black hoodie, gold crown pendant, dark cargo trousers and brown heavy boots, cyan light from viewer-right and magenta edge light from viewer-left. This is not a new character. Row 1 left: head including hat, beard and short neck, eyes open. Row 1 center: identical head, size/view/position identical within cell, eyes CLOSED for blink, everything else unchanged. Row 1 right: orange vest and black hoodie TORSO from collar to waist, including chain and crown pendant, NO head and NO arms; reconstruct hidden cloth under shoulders with generous overlap tabs. Row 2 left: hips, BOTH trouser legs and boots as one planted lower-body piece, NO upper body; reconstruct waist overlap. Row 2 center: viewer-left black hoodie UPPER ARM, shoulder to rolled sleeve at elbow, angled down-left, no forearm. Row 2 right: viewer-left bare FOREARM and relaxed HAND, from elbow to fingers, angled slightly down-right, same anatomy and five fingers. Row 3 left: viewer-right black hoodie UPPER ARM from shoulder to elbow, angled down-right, no forearm. Row 3 center: viewer-right bare FOREARM and gripping HAND, from elbow to closed grip, angled up-right, fingers around an invisible rod handle; NO rod. Row 3 right: full slender dark fishing ROD with gold guide rings, gold/blue REEL and handle, isolated with no hand, angled from bottom-left to top-right. Complete hidden edges at all joints, no severed sharp straight cuts; use rounded overlapping ends. Preserve reference materials, proportions and semi-realistic illustrated game-art finish. No effects, glow halos, shadows on a floor, extra limbs, loose unrelated objects, text or watermark. Each piece entirely within its cell.
prompts.marina: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: registered clean background plate for an animated game marina, opaque 16:9. Input image is the exact edit target. Preserve camera, horizon, all architecture, all pier posts, lamps, palms, moon, night sky, neon colors, water texture and overall painting style. REMOVE ONLY all boats and their masts and rigging, including the large black motor yacht at the left and white yacht at the right. Reconstruct the hidden docks/buildings/water behind them faithfully so separate boats can rock without exposing holes. Also remove ONLY the strong magenta boat reflection underneath the left motor yacht and turquoise boat reflection underneath the right yacht; replace those with darker rippled navy water. Retain shore lamp reflections and moon reflection. No UI, no new objects, no changes in horizon or perspective, no crop, no added text. This is a production clean plate for reassembly, not a redesigned landscape.
prompts.boats: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent two-boat animation atlas, wide landscape. Input image is the marina identity/style reference. Extract/reconstruct exactly its TWO main motor yachts as isolated transparent sprites. LEFT HALF of output: the left-side black/navy motor yacht, bow pointing viewer-right, magenta-purple illuminated hull, full windshield, cabin, railings and antennas, identical three-quarter viewing angle. RIGHT HALF: right-side white motor yacht, bow pointing viewer-left, cyan/teal hull lighting, full cabin and railings. Keep both yachts completely inside their halves with generous gutters. Reconstruct the hull silhouette down to the waterline including hidden lower edge so each can rock by two degrees. No water, NO reflections, NO pier posts, NO mooring lines connecting to scenery, no backdrop, NO baked halos, no text, no extra boats. Real alpha transparency. Match the exact crisp illustrative materials and night lighting of the supplied scene.
prompts.fishermanCleanup: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production 3x3 rig atlas with genuine transparency. Edit the supplied atlas only in the TOP LEFT and TOP CENTER cells. Remove ALL clothing, hoodie collar, gold chain and crown pendant from BOTH heads. Leave only the exact existing hat, hair, face, beard and a short plain neck that ends just below the beard, with a rounded overlapping neck end. The head placements, sizes, facial features, one eyes-open and one eyes-closed, and lighting must remain pixel-aligned with this image. EVERY OTHER CELL stays unchanged. Do not repaint torso, arms, rod or legs. No labels, no background, no extra objects. Transparent background and gutters stay transparent.
prompts.reflections: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent reflection atlas for the two referenced marina boats. Wide canvas with two equal halves. LEFT: soft magenta-purple and a few warm gold broken horizontal ripple streaks, longest/brightest at the top and scattered progressively narrower, dimmer and softer downward. RIGHT: same but cyan-teal with a few warm gold streaks. Each reflection is a tall tapered pool of reflected boat light, not a literal flipped boat image. Transparent gaps between ALL water streaks, no opaque blue or black background, no solid triangle silhouette, no boat, no sparkles, no labels. Art: natural luminous brush-painted reflections matching the supplied marina's water, not vector neon lines. Leave transparent 10% gutters around each half. These layers will distort separately from the rocking boats.
prompts.surfaceFX: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: two isolated specular accents for the existing gold/enamel and foil-wrapped slot symbols. Wide canvas, two equal halves, true transparent background. LEFT: one fine diagonal ivory-white specular brush stroke running lower-left to upper-right, bright narrow core with very restrained warm gold tapered edges; small and polished, no circular bloom. RIGHT: one compact asymmetrical four-point jewelled light catch, white center, two long thin diagonals and two shorter points, subtle emerald-cyan and warm gold edge. Keep both accents crisp at tiny sizes and fully within their own halves. No symbol, no lettering, no stars elsewhere, no circle, no lens flare rings, no particles, no background. Light comes from upper-left, same premium illustrated material system as the provided KING crown and foil packages.
prompts.torsoCleanup: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: torso-only cutout for layered 2D character rig. Input is the exact torso edit target. Keep the orange fishing vest, black hoodie, gold chain and crown pendant, proportions, front three-quarter angle, folds, cyan-right and magenta-left lighting identical. Fix only the shoulder construction: the viewer-left shoulder currently looks like a dark empty oval hole with an outlined rim. Remove the empty socket appearance and paint continuous BLACK HOODIE FABRIC through both arm openings, extending a small rounded shoulder overlap tab under where a separate sleeve attaches. The torso must look like a complete clothed body behind separate upper-arm layers, not a hollow garment. No attached full arms, no head, no legs, no new jewellery. Clean alpha edges with NO stray red/blue pixels or rectangular artifacts. Genuine transparency. Tight complete cutout with no crop of the vest.
